_meta.source: Ported from ski-platform/apps/web/messages/en.json (slopeAuthor namespace) on 2026-05-08. Keep in sync when ski-platform updates upstream strings.

slopeAuthor.title: Resort Editor
slopeAuthor.selectHint: Click an existing slope / lift / node to load its editor
slopeAuthor.pickHint: Click drops a pin + fetches elevation
slopeAuthor.drawSlopeHint: Click to add vertices, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel
slopeAuthor.drawLiftHint: Click to add vertices, Enter to finish, Esc to cancel
slopeAuthor.editSlopeGeomHint: Selected slope's polyline becomes editable: drag, insert, append, delete vertices
slopeAuthor.editLiftGeomHint: Selected lift's polyline becomes editable: drag, insert, append, delete vertices
slopeAuthor.addNodeHint: Drop a graph node (POI / station / fork)
slopeAuthor.connectNodesHint: Pick two nodes → create an edge between them
slopeAuthor.newPlaceHint: New place will appear in the dropdown after merge + index
